_comment: Key-off transient capture (two channels). On key-off CH1 falls 14->0 V - that is the trigger event - and CH2 rises 0->5 V a moment later; this grabs both in one 40 s record. METHOD OF CAPTURE: trigger on CH1 FALLING edge at 6.8 V (~half of 14 V), trigger_mode NORMal so the scope WAITS for the real key-off instead of free-running (AUTO would force-trigger early and miss the event). Capture single-shot - arm and wait: configure_scope(alias, 'bench_full', '1,2', duration_s=40) then capture_scope(alias, '1,2', single=True, timeout_s=<key-off within this>). Ch1/Ch2: 5 V/div, 1 MOhm, 500 MHz. Horizontal: 4 s/div (40 s total), 250 S/s, 10 kpts, position 10%. Acquisition: Manual, Sample. WINDOW: pass duration_s=40 to configure_scope for this test (40 s total = 4 s/div x 10).
name: bench_full
